strings.Философия DS PROAUDIO: свой путь в разра: The DS PROAUDIO philosophy: our own path in engineering, care for everyone who works with our equipment, and sound without a signature coloration of its own.
strings.Мы с большим уважением относимся к нашим: We have deep respect for our peers at other manufacturers, especially those who change the industry and set its quality standards. We study their experience closely and admire their breakthroughs.
strings.Но у нас свой путь — мы никогда не повто: But we follow our own path. We never copy other people’s solutions: even when a technology catches our interest, we rebuild it from scratch until we arrive at a better result.
strings.Мы — большая команда единомышленников, г: We are a large team of like-minded people, and each of us puts our best into the common cause.
strings.И мы заботимся обо всех, кто соприкасает: And we care about everyone who touches our equipment at every stage of its life cycle: not only the listener, but also the sound engineers, system engineers and installation partners.

strings.Юрий Михайлович Старченко родился в Лени: Yuri Starchenko was born in Leningrad in 1954.
strings.Музыка всегда играла важную роль в его ж: Music has always played an important part in his life, and that may well be where his passion for acoustics began. He has devoted nearly 50 years to this fascinating field, with a degree from the Leningrad Electrotechnical Institute behind him.
strings.Его путь начался ещё в советское время с: His path began back in Soviet times, repairing loudspeakers.
strings.Затем судьба привела его к участию в соз: Later he helped build what became the largest manufacturer of professional loudspeaker equipment in the former Soviet Union.
strings.Компания гордилась тем, что её разработк: The company was proud that its designs were in demand not only in Russia but abroad: it worked with European and American companies and represented the country at international trade shows in Frankfurt and Los Angeles.
strings.В 2000 году Юрий Михайлович основал собс: In 2000, Yuri founded his own manufacturing company. Alongside civilian loudspeaker equipment, the company also handles defense contracts, supplying products for the Ministry of Defense and other government agencies.
strings.Уже 25 лет он с гордостью руководит этим: He has proudly led it for 25 years.
strings.Главным достижением за это время Юрий Ми: He considers his greatest achievement to be building a team of engineers unique in Russia.
strings.Компании удалось выстроить производство: The company built full-cycle production, from winding a voice coil to building complex line arrays.
strings.В начале 2019 года Юрий Михайлович с энт: In early 2019, Yuri enthusiastically backed the idea of reviving the production of concert sound equipment.
strings.Так и появилась компания DS PROAUDIO, в: That is how DS PROAUDIO came about. He sees it as the embodiment of his lifelong passion for acoustics and his drive to create the highest-quality sound for everyone.
strings.Вячеслав Моцар – директор по развитию ко: Vyacheslav Motsar is Business Development Director at DS PROAUDIO, an entrepreneur and a musician whose passion for music is inseparable from the world of pro audio.
strings.В своей жизни он руководствуется принцип: He lives by the principles in his favorite sayings: “Fortune favors the bold” and “The road is conquered by those who walk it.” These words keep him striving for new achievements and always moving forward.
strings.Погружение Вячеслава в мир Pro-аудио нач: Vyacheslav’s journey into pro audio started with music. He studied violin and piano at music school, then taught himself guitar and drums.
strings.Играя в рок-группе, он в какой-то момент: Playing in a rock band, at some point he wanted to capture his musical ideas. That meant learning sound recording, so that his music would not be lost to posterity.
strings.Со временем сам процесс звукозаписи стал: Over time, the recording process itself became as rewarding as the result. Mastering the gear, studying the parameters, understanding how every knob shapes the sound: all of this drew him into a completely different side of the music industry.
strings.И, как логичное продолжение, Вячеслав пр: As a natural next step, Vyacheslav joined a company that sold and installed sound equipment. He found the field fascinating, and in 2009 he founded his own company, Deep Sound.
strings.С тех пор компания оснастила десятки объ: Since then, Deep Sound has equipped dozens of venues of every size and complexity, mastered system design and visualization, and built a team of talented, dedicated specialists.
strings.Когда Вячеславу предложили не просто «пр: When Vyacheslav was invited not just to sell equipment but to help create it, he gladly accepted and threw himself into the work. It let him combine his two greatest passions, gear and creativity, from an unexpected and very exciting angle.
strings.В DS PROAUDIO Вячеслав отвечает за превр: At DS PROAUDIO, Vyacheslav is responsible for turning great loudspeakers into a great product and for getting the word about it to as many people as possible.
strings.Он руководит концепцией новых продуктов,: He leads new product concepts, works with partners and engineers, and oversees technical support, service, documentation and supply planning.
strings.Этот комплекс действий направлен на то,: All of this aims to make sure our loudspeaker systems not only sound great but are also convenient and pleasant to work with at every stage.

strings.Николай Мильков родился и вырос в Ленинг: Nikolay Milkov was born and raised in Leningrad, now St. Petersburg.
strings.Всё началось с музыки. С 15 лет Николай: It all started with music. From the age of 15 Nikolay played bass in a band, and by 18 he knew exactly what he wanted to do with his life. He called a loudspeaker factory outside St. Petersburg himself, and was turned down.
strings.Но через пять лет, в 2004 году, он сдела: Five years later, in 2004, he tried again and joined Yuri Starchenko’s company. After four years of work combined with constant study, Nikolay was designing new loudspeaker systems on his own, and by 2013 he had developed several unique solutions for special applications and become one of the company’s co-owners.
strings.С тех пор Николай является главным конст: Since then, Nikolay has been chief designer in two fields at once: professional audio, and specialized public address and acoustic test equipment.
strings.На его счету уже пять действующих патент: He holds five active patents for acoustic devices and technologies (three of them used in DS PROAUDIO production models). He has also delivered several large, one-of-a-kind high-SPL acoustic test projects for leading aerospace companies, set up series production of HF compression drivers, and written acoustic simulation software.
strings.В 2019 году Николай первым сформулировал: In 2019, Nikolay was the first to put forward the idea of a new brand, a manufacturer of professional loudspeaker systems, and found a partner in Moscow, Vyacheslav Motsar. Together they launched DS PROAUDIO.
strings.Для нового проекта Николай разработал вс: For the new venture, Nikolay designed the entire product range, covering acoustics as well as mechanics and rigging.
strings.Сегодня он продолжает разрабатывать новы: Today he keeps developing new products, now together with a much larger team of like-minded people, and plays an active role in growing the DS PROAUDIO brand and shaping the company’s strategy, goals and philosophy.
strings.Посвятил работе в музыкальной индустрии: He has devoted more than 50 years to the music industry, building up unique experience and knowledge.

strings.Этим предприятием была EVM — бренд, кото: That company was EVM, a brand known in the 90s to practically everyone in the pro audio business. EVM was replacing imports with domestic products long before anyone talked about sanctions; it exported actively and had offices in Los Angeles (EVM-USA) and Nice (EVM-France). Back then, “made in Russia” really meant made, not just assembled. Production of the first branded drivers was set up as a joint venture with specialists from the American company McCauley, which went on to become a regular EVM customer. The legendary Genelec 1035A studio monitor was built with Russian drivers, and a collaboration with the German HF driver maker BMS added LF and MF drivers to the BMS range, drivers that world-famous companies such as L-Acoustics use to this day.
strings.Но в конце 1990-х компания, к тому момен: But in the late 1990s the company, which by then held substantial assets, fell victim to a hostile corporate raid and effectively ceased to exist as Russia’s largest loudspeaker manufacturer.

strings.2022 год стал для отрасли переломным: ух: 2022 was a turning point for the industry. strings.Данный комплект в серии CX можно назвать: This is arguably the most versatile system in the CX series. The 12" satellites reproduce the midrange in detail, and the 18" subwoofers guarantee enough bass for almost any genre. A great solution for live bands, presentations, assembly halls and clubs (including karaoke).
strings.Данный комплект в большей степени подойд: This system is best suited to clubs and jobs where bass and mid-bass matter more than midrange detail. Still, don’t rule it out for live bands: the difference from the 12" satellite system isn’t huge, and good mid-bass never hurts. It all depends on the genre, the required level and the room.
strings.Самый бескомпромиссный комплект серии. И: The most uncompromising system in the series. strings.Элемент линейного массива TAURA 8 создан: The TAURA 8 line array element is built on a unique hybrid design. The HF section is conventional: two waveguide-loaded drivers with ring diaphragms and 1.5” voice coils.
strings.Особенность конструкции TAURA 8 заключае: What sets TAURA 8 apart is that its LF section (2 × 8”) is also loaded on a waveguide that doubles as a horn, raising driver efficiency. Instead of two point sources in the LF range, the design gives a single radiating source whose wavefront is optimal both for summing with the HF section and for coupling between array elements.

strings.Сабвуфер TAURA C-Sub 18 включает в себя: The TAURA C-Sub 18 subwoofer brings some notable engineering. Cardioid dispersion has long been the standard in concert sound reinforcement. Achieving it with a single amplifier channel, however, is an outstanding result.
strings.В сабвуфере TAURA C-Sub 18 параметры выч: In the TAURA C-Sub 18, the cancellation between the front and rear drivers is set by the enclosure design itself. The drivers deserve a special mention: the 18” front driver has an impedance of 12 Ω and the 12” rear driver 24 Ω. This unusual combination gives a total system impedance of 8 Ω, a familiar and convenient value for running several subwoofers in parallel.

strings.Кардиоидный сабвуфер TAURA C-Sub 18 — DS: TAURA C-Sub 18 cardioid subwoofer — DS PROAUDIO
strings.Кардиоидный сабвуфер. Один канал усилени: Cardioid subwoofer. A single amplifier channel. Up to −10 dB rear rejection. 8 Ω nominal impedance.
strings.Как часто звук на сцене превращается в «: How often does the sound on stage turn to mush?
strings.Низкие частоты имеют свойство огибать пр: Low frequencies tend to wrap around obstacles. At typical concerts, subwoofers fire not only into the audience but also backward, making musicians uncomfortable and causing extra reflections off the back wall. That muddies the overall sound picture.
strings.TAURA C-Sub 18 решает эту задачу на уров: TAURA C-Sub 18 solves this at the level of physics
strings.Наша конструкция формирует кардиоидную д: Our design produces a cardioid dispersion pattern. Low-frequency energy is concentrated in front of the subwoofer, while the space behind it stays clean. The stage becomes comfortable for performers, and the sound in the house becomes clear and powerful.
strings.Круговая и кардиоидная диаграммы направл: Omnidirectional and cardioid subwoofer dispersion patterns
strings.Кардиоида без компромиссов. И без лишних: Cardioid without compromise. And without extra cost.
strings.Обычно для построения кардиоидной систем: A cardioid setup usually takes two amplifier channels and complex processing, with the rear driver’s output “subtracted” from the front driver’s. That’s expensive and cumbersome.
strings.Наши инженеры пошли другим путём. Мы зап: Our engineers took a different route: we programmed the physics of the enclosure. The cancellation between the front and rear drivers is set at the enclosure design stage. You just feed the signal to one amplifier channel, and the system creates the right pattern by itself.
strings.Конструкция представляет собой два объед: The design combines two subwoofers in a single enclosure: an 18″ direct-radiating driver (1) with a bass-reflex port (2), and a 12″ driver in a two-chamber band-pass enclosure with two bass-reflex ports (3) located on the rear panel.
The 18″ works as a classic subwoofer. The 12″ is tuned to radiate an identical signal backward, the only difference being that its phase is inverted by 180°. This provides −10 dB of cancellation behind the system across almost the entire operating range. The 12″ driver has virtually no effect on front output.
strings.Уникальное решение нашего одноканального: A unique feature of our single-channel cardioid subwoofer: all ports (both on the front 18″ and the rear 12″) have a variable cross-section, giving the whole system unprecedented efficiency.
strings.12″ громкоговоритель в оформлении бэнд‑п: 12″ driver in a band-pass enclosure with rear-panel ports (3)
strings.Мы используем два разных громкоговорител: We use two different drivers. Thanks to an unconventional impedance ratio, their parallel connection inside the enclosure gives a familiar, convenient system impedance.
strings.Вы можете подключать сабвуферы параллель: You can connect the subwoofers in parallel, like ordinary 8 Ω systems, without worrying about the impedance dropping below what your amplifier can handle. We built a powerful cardioid system that works with standard amplifier inventories.
strings.вы получаете идеальный контроль над низк: you get perfect low-frequency control while saving money on extra amplifiers and processing channels.
strings.Подавление звуковой энергии в тыловой по: Sound energy in the rear hemisphere is suppressed by up to −10 dB. That means on stage you hear the music, not subwoofer rumble.
strings.Артисты слышат себя и друг друга. Миниму: Performers can hear themselves and each other. Minimal reflections off the back wall. An ideal solution for indoor venues and large festival stages.
strings.Всего 1 канал усиления на корпус. Эконом: Just one amplifier channel per enclosure. Savings on amplifiers and processors make this system affordable with no loss in quality.

strings.В большинстве наших акустических систем: Most of our loudspeakers use coaxial drivers: the midrange and high-frequency transducers sit on the same axis (co-axial). We made this choice for a reason.
strings.Одним из важнейших качественных параметр: One of the most important quality parameters of modern loudspeakers is the dispersion pattern, or more precisely, the phase and frequency uniformity of coverage across the space (frequency and phase response). This uniformity makes it possible to deliver high-quality music reproduction to a large number of listeners at once.
strings.Особенно это актуально на малых и средни: This matters especially at short and medium distances, where the fact that different frequency ranges are reproduced by different transducers cannot be fully evened out by the distance between the loudspeaker and the listeners.
strings.Там, где слух особенно чувствителен: Where our hearing is most sensitive
strings.Наиболее уязвимой для ФЧХ является облас: The region most vulnerable in terms of phase response is the crossover between the MF and HF transducers, the frequency range where the MF driver is still playing and the HF driver is already coming in. Here, interference significantly undermines the formation of an even dispersion pattern.
strings.Проблема усугубляется тем, что физиологи: The problem is compounded by the fact that, physiologically, our hearing is especially sensitive to phase distortion at precisely these frequencies. This has to do with how the wavelengths and half-wavelengths in this range relate to the size of our head, or more precisely, the distance between our ears.
strings.Наряду с некоторыми другими способами вл: Among the various ways of addressing this problem, the most effective is to use coaxial drivers at short and medium distances. This eliminates interference and stabilizes the phase and frequency response as much as possible in the critical frequency range, ensuring sound quality across the full width of the loudspeaker’s dispersion pattern.

strings.Недостатки — и как мы их решаем: Drawbacks, and how we address them
strings.Главный недостаток коаксиала — сложность: The main drawback of a coaxial design is its complexity, which affects both manufacturing cost and final power handling. We make all our drivers, from 4 to 18″, ourselves, so the final cost of the product is considerably lower than with imported drivers.
strings.Повышения итоговой мощности и надёжности: We increased the driver’s final power handling and reliability with our own voice coil manufacturing technology.
strings.Без специальных волноводов высокие часто: Without dedicated waveguides, high frequencies have a fairly wide dispersion pattern, which makes long-throw work difficult. In the CX and ANT series we don’t use HF horns: this gives excellent frequency and phase response uniformity in the near and mid field, and these systems aren’t designed for long distances anyway.
strings.Коаксиальные акустические системы, актив: Coaxial loudspeakers, active and passive subwoofers, and systems.
strings.Коаксиальные мониторы, которые работают: Coaxial monitors that double as versatile point sources.
strings.Для работы на дальние дистанции мы приме: For long throw distances we use coaxial drivers with waveguides, in the ERA and TAURA series.

strings.В подавляющем большинстве акустических с: In the vast majority of loudspeakers, the HF driver and LF driver are mounted side by side. It seems logical. But acoustics doesn’t tolerate compromise: with this layout, the acoustic centers don’t coincide.
strings.В результате звуковые волны проходят раз: As a result, the sound waves travel different distances to the listener’s ear, and interference occurs at the crossover (in the critical 0.8–1.3 kHz region). The dispersion pattern becomes asymmetric. Moving left or right off axis, the listener hears a different “picture,” with dips or peaks at the most important musical frequencies.
strings.схема «Плохое решение»: два излучателя р: diagram “Poor solution”: two transducers side by side, waves fanning out from different centers
strings.Асимметричная ДН. Нестабильность тональн: Asymmetric dispersion. Unstable tonal balance as the listener moves
strings.Одна точка излучения. Симметрия для всег: One point of radiation. Symmetry for the whole house.
DS PROAUDIO engineers took a different route. In our ERA and TAURA series we use a coaxial layout. The HF driver with its waveguide sits precisely at the center of the low-frequency (or midrange) driver. They share a common radiation axis. This means sound from both sources comes from a single acoustic point.
strings.Сфазированность волн на всех частотах. З: Waves in phase at all frequencies. Sound reaches the listener as a single whole.
strings.Левый и правый край зала слышат звук оди: The left and right sides of the house hear the sound the same way. No “shifted” tonal balance.
strings.Провалы в АЧХ в области кроссовера сведе: Frequency response dips in the crossover region are kept to a minimum. Vocals and instruments sound clear and natural anywhere in the venue.
strings.схема «Наше решение»: из центра динамика: diagram “Our solution”: a single spherical wave emanates from the center of the driver
strings.Симметричная горизонтальная ДН. Стабильн: Symmetrical horizontal dispersion. Stable tonal balance at any point
strings.Однако просто поместить драйвер внутрь д: But simply placing the driver inside the woofer isn’t enough. The waveguide plays the key role. It doesn’t just direct the sound; it shapes the very dispersion pattern the system needs to work as part of a line array (TAURA) or a scalable point source (ERA). We designed the waveguide to provide:
strings.Необходимую ширину вертикальной диаграмм: The required vertical dispersion width over a controlled frequency range, which is critical when several modules are assembled into an array.
strings.Когерентное сложение в горизонтальной пл: Coherent summation in the horizontal plane without unwanted “humps” and “dips,” for even coverage of the venue.

strings.Мы создаём наши акустические системы для: We build our loudspeakers to bring the full beauty of music to every listener, wherever they are in the room. Coaxial technology is our main tool for achieving this. It means the sound engineer never has to settle for a “compromise” tuning that averages the sound between the center and the sides. Tune the system once, and it sounds right for everyone. That is our responsibility to the people who make music and to those who listen to it.

strings.Горизонтальное сложение источников звука: Horizontal summing of sound sources is an engineering approach that rethinks how loudspeaker systems are built. We combine multiple drivers into a single radiating wavefront, achieving coherent summation of sound waves across the entire reproduced frequency range. The result is a symmetrical horizontal dispersion pattern free of interference artifacts, with high efficiency and reliability.
strings.Почему мы пошли другим путём: Why we took a different path
strings.Традиционные линейные массивы неизбежно: Conventional line arrays inevitably run into interference in the horizontal plane. Placing drivers to the left and right of the HF section creates zones where waves either add up or cancel out. This leads to uneven coverage and “nulls” in certain frequency ranges.
strings.Мы решили эту задачу иначе. Наша запатен: We solved this problem differently. Our patented technology is based on coherent horizontal waveguide summing. Thanks to a unique geometry, several waveguides combine and work as one, forming a single wavefront.
strings.Также мы применили эту технологию в сист: We also applied this technology in the PILLAR systems, where we needed to increase the power reserve and reliability of the HF section without changing the sonic character delivered by a single large waveguide.

strings.Горизонтальная диаграмма направленности: The horizontal dispersion pattern stays perfectly even across the entire operating range. Coverage is predictable and uniform — no “good” and “bad” seats in the house.
strings.Несколько волноводов работают как единый: Several waveguides work as a single radiator. Energy sums constructively, without phase distortion, giving the system high efficiency.
strings.Когерентное сложение позволяет получить: Coherent summation delivers more output with lower distortion. The system “breathes” freely instead of squeezing the last bit out of its components.
strings.Классическая проблема гребенчатых фильтр: The classic problem of comb filtering and uneven frequency response in the horizontal plane is solved at the acoustic design stage of the waveguides.

strings.Мы разрабатываем эти механизмы так же тщ: We develop these mechanisms with the same care we put into designing waveguides.
strings.Минимальный зазор между штифтами из высо: Minimal clearance between the high-strength steel pins and the mating holes in the locks ensures maximum contact area between structural elements. This eliminates play even after repeated lifts.
strings.Все части механизмов имеют защитное покр: All mechanism parts have a protective coating and are corrosion-resistant.

Instead of two point sources in the LF range, you get a single source with a wavefront optimized both for summing with the HF section and for summing the array elements with each other.
strings.Волновод состоит из трёх частей:: The waveguide consists of three parts:
strings.превращает сферические фронты 8″ громког: converts the spherical wavefronts of the 8″ drivers into cylindrical ones, which is needed for correct summing of array elements in the midrange.
strings.объединяет два НЧ‑излучателя в один исто: combines the two LF drivers into a single source and eliminates horizontal interference.
strings.работает как рупор и формирует горизонта: acts as a horn and shapes the horizontal dispersion pattern.

strings.Итог: на средних частотах не две сфериче: The result: in the midrange, instead of two spherical waves there is one cylindrical wave, giving an even horizontal dispersion pattern and coherent summation of both HF and LF drivers.

strings.Отработали с системой DS PROAUDIO Taura: We used the DS PROAUDIO Taura system for Elena Vaenga’s solo concert in Reutov. It’s probably the first Russian-made loudspeaker system I have no complaints or questions about at all. Everything went quickly and smoothly: setup was simple, and the tuning turned out really well. I got exactly the sound I wanted. These are the best Russian-made speakers I’ve come across.
strings.Особенно отмечу среднечастотный диапазон: I’d especially point out the midrange: it’s punchy yet very controlled, which made dialing in the instruments and vocals much easier.
strings.На сцене «Маяк» мы работали с российским: On the Mayak stage we worked with the Russian manufacturer DS PROAUDIO. We used an interesting Taura configuration: five cardioid subwoofers and five tops per side. It was great, with more than enough sound. I’d especially point out the midrange: it’s punchy yet very controlled, which made dialing in the instruments and vocals much easier. The guests loved it, and so did we and the organizing team.
strings.Здесь же он звучал мягко и естественно,: Here, though, it sounded soft and natural, with no harshness, giving the sound density and warmth. This is not a harsh-sounding box.
strings.Посчастливилось поработать на акустике T: I was lucky enough to work on the Taura system with a live band at the Sound Engineers Congress in Samara. I really liked it.
strings.Звук насыщенный в нижнем и среднем диапа: The sound is rich in the low end and midrange, which was a pleasant surprise for me, since I usually don’t care much for that range. Here, though, it sounded soft and natural, with no harshness, giving the sound density and warmth. This is not a harsh-sounding box. If you get a chance to work on it, I think you’ll really enjoy it.
strings.концертный звукорежиссёр, начальник ради: concert sound engineer, head of audio at the Moscow Youth Theater
strings.С колонками DS PROAUDIO Pillar, которые: The Bessonnitsa festival was my first time with DS PROAUDIO Pillar speakers, and I really liked them. The system was complemented by ERA 18" passive subwoofers. The result was a very balanced sound with excellent clarity, good SPL and dynamics. The speakers are very responsive and easy and pleasant to work with.
strings.Система стояла на малой сцене, и многие: The system was set up on the small stage, and many people said that this year it became one of the best spots of the whole festival, both for the sound and the design.
strings.В массиве DS PROAUDIO Taura меня особенн: What I particularly enjoyed about the DS PROAUDIO Taura array was the low-frequency section. The highs sound refined, which is rare for small formats that are usually harsh and “sizzly.” Taura was a pleasure precisely because of its smooth sound.
strings.Это универсальная система: на разных ист: It’s a versatile system: it sounds good with different sources and different kinds of music. The engineers did a great job; it’s a superb design. It’s doubly gratifying that localization and production are almost 100 percent. That’s very rare these days. Compared with systems of a similar class from well-known manufacturers, Taura clearly comes out ahead. It’s my favorite, and I recommend it without hesitation for any application.
strings.Массив Taura – долгожданная новинка от о: The Taura array is a long-awaited new product from a Russian manufacturer, and once it became available, we decided to put it to the test.
strings.Модели бренда DS PROAUDIO, в частности P: We’ve been using DS PROAUDIO models, Pillar in particular, for several years now. The Taura array is a long-awaited new product from a Russian manufacturer, and once it became available, we decided to put it to the test.
strings.Первый опыт был на выставке в Самаре, вт: The first time was at a trade show in Samara, the second at the Mir Palace of Culture in Reutov. I liked the system, but I judge it from a production standpoint. What matters most is the opinion of the sound engineers and our end clients.
strings.Я буду рекомендовать Taura, а результат: I’ll be recommending Taura, and time will tell how it works out.
strings.Мы работали с системой DS PROAUDIO Taura: We worked with the DS PROAUDIO Taura system at Alexey Glyzin’s solo concert in Reutov. The system has even coverage: on the balcony, at the front and under the balcony, the sound is dense and high quality. As the volume went up, there were no spurious resonances.
strings.Это не «кричащий» аппарат с запасом чувс: It’s not a “shouty” box that relies on extra sensitivity. I’d be happy to work with it again, for example at an open-air venue, since a hall always has its own acoustic quirks and characteristic resonances.
strings.Я несу ответственность за создание безуп: I’m responsible for creating a flawless technical environment for tens of thousands of guests and hundreds of participants. Sound is one of the key elements of that environment. For the second year running, we’ve been using audio equipment from the Russian manufacturer DS PROAUDIO across different venues, at screens and music stages. Almost the entire product range was in use: a set of Pillar columns on the small stage, the “small” ERA constant-curvature array at the river screen, and the flagship Taura line array on the main stage.
strings.«Бессонница» отличается сложной специфик: Bessonnitsa is especially challenging to cover with sound, since it’s an animation film festival. We have many “sound-producing” locations, including music stages that must not interfere with each other, and especially not with screenings of the main program. DS PROAUDIO handled the job brilliantly: both the team and the equipment performed at a high level. We achieved even coverage, precise zoning and a natural tonal balance at every venue. I’d especially like to note that there were no technical failures at all: everything ran as planned. Thank you for the great speakers, the support and the result!
strings.Характер отклика оказался исключительным: The response was exceptional, delivering transparent, clean sound.
strings.На конгрессе звукорежиссёров я протестир: At the Sound Engineers Congress, I tested DS PROAUDIO Pillar (A) loudspeakers while mixing my own multitrack. I was sure they would perform well, but the result exceeded all expectations. The response was exceptional, delivering transparent, clean sound. My thanks to the company’s engineers for their professionalism and quality approach to equipment design.
strings.системный инженер. Автор и преподаватель: system engineer; author and instructor of the “Applied System Engineering” course at Show Crew Academy
strings.ERA с субами вызвала исключительно полож: ERA with the subs drew nothing but positive reactions from all the students, which is pretty much what I expected.
strings.Когда приходит время выбирать громкогово: When it’s time to choose loudspeakers for the hands-on part of a seminar, I have to weigh several things. First, the loudspeakers must be good enough that I can recommend them and give them to students as a reference for their acoustic experience. Second, I need to pick loudspeakers from different manufacturers (so it isn’t too easy) and make sure they play nicely together (so it isn’t too hard).
strings.Так как обычно первый производитель на п: Since I usually know the first manufacturer at the venue in advance (we always use the in-house system), I can generally pick the second one from a fairly wide range. In Saint Petersburg I had plenty of options, because as I saw it, quite a lot of loudspeakers could get along with the house system. In Moscow, though, things were a bit different.
strings.Там местной системой была линейка моделе: There, the house system was a range from a German manufacturer whose main selling point is very meticulous component selection and tight consistency of parameters and sound across elements. That put serious limits on which models from other manufacturers could keep it company and form a proper system with it, giving students confidence that they had done everything right.
strings.Студентов в Москве было много, рисковать: There were a lot of students in Moscow, and I couldn’t afford to take risks, so I turned to my old friends at DS PROAUDIO and asked them to lend us speakers for the hands-on part of the seminar. We’ve known each other for a long time, so I can always be sure that even if I get a new model I’ve never heard, our idea of what makes a “good speaker” is, if not identical, then very close, and I’ll be happy either way.
strings.Так и получилось. Чаще всего в экзаменац: And that’s how it turned out. The models that came up most often in my exam questions were ERA and its companion S18. The sub is simply a good single-18″ subwoofer (I no longer believe you can do anything amazing there; it’s either bad or good), but the phase linearity of ERA itself made many of the students irresistibly want to take a picture of it. That was nice to see, but also a little hurtful in a way: why should a phase-linear speaker from a Russian manufacturer be such a curiosity?
strings.Во всяком случае ERA с субами вызвала ис: In any case, ERA with the subs drew nothing but positive reactions from all the students, which is pretty much what I expected. The CX108 8″ coaxial (commonly called “the cube”) may not match some of its foreign counterparts in low-end output (possibly only because they use dark magic), but it is just as linear and tonally pleasing as the other DS models.
strings.Единственное, о чём жалею – что к момент: My only regret is that the new cardioid subs hadn’t been released yet at the time of the seminar. I would have loved to watch the wow effect on the students’ faces as they walked around a sub the size of any 18″ sub that somehow achieves such convincing rear cancellation from a single pair of pins (I think that dark magic has finally been discovered).
strings.В целом я искренне надеюсь, что рынок от: Overall, I sincerely hope the Russian loudspeaker market keeps developing and growing (including its own amplification and processing) and that our students, while preparing a venue for a show, can breathe a sigh of relief at the sight of familiar speakers made in our country, which has always been strong in engineers.
strings.А я в свою очередь, планирую видеться с: For my part, I plan to keep meeting DS systems at my seminars (and at venues, too) in the future.
strings.актер, музыкант, основатель и руководите: actor, musician, founder and head of the Zavod theater company
strings.Протестировав линейный массив Taura от D: After testing the Taura line array from DS PROAUDIO, I was pleasantly impressed.
strings.Признаюсь, отправляясь на прослушивание: I’ll admit that when I went to hear a Russian-designed loudspeaker system, I expected some shortcomings. However, after testing the Taura line array from DS PROAUDIO, I was pleasantly impressed. As a performer and event organizer with more than twenty years of experience in stage sound, I can say I now genuinely want to work with this equipment, both with a band and on theater projects.
strings.заведующий звукоцехом и выпускающий звук: head of sound and show engineer, Young Actor Children’s Musical Theater; presales engineer for mixing systems at Constage
strings.Всегда после прослушивания у меня остают: I always come away from a listening session with a very good impression.
strings.Акустику DS PROAUDIO я слышала на разных: I’ve heard DS PROAUDIO loudspeakers at various events: at the Sound Engineers Congress and at loud booths at various trade shows, and I always come away from a listening session with a very good impression.
strings.Благодаря вам, главная сцена фестиваля з: Thanks to you, the festival’s main stage sounds better than ever!
strings.На конгрессе звукорежиссёров в г. Самара: At the Sound Engineers Congress in Samara
strings.Впервые с линейным массивом Taura я позн: I first got to know the Taura line array at the Light + Audio Tec show in 2024, and it made a strong impression on me. Now, at the congress, I can fully appreciate its capabilities, since it’s installed on the main stage and will be used throughout the entire program. I’m also glad to be working with the DS PROAUDIO team at the Bessonnitsa International Festival, where I am the chief audio engineer. In 2025, we plan to use this array on the festival’s main music stage.
strings.В этом году на нашем фестивале компания: This year DS PROAUDIO supplied its TAURA line array for our festival. Guys, I just want to say a big thank you! Thanks to you, the festival’s main stage sounds better than ever!
strings.звукорежиссёр Дворца культуры металлурго: sound engineer, Sergo Ordzhonikidze Metallurgists’ Palace of Culture
strings.Я давно знаком с компанией DS PROAUDIO и: I’ve known DS PROAUDIO and their loudspeakers for a long time. It’s great to see the team building truly professional, high-end products, constantly growing and bringing in new ideas. I especially liked the rigging concept of their line array. I genuinely support manufacturers who design their own drivers. It’s an extremely important and demanding technological process that calls for high precision and repeatability.
strings.Ребята – молодцы, постоянно совершенству: Great job, guys: you keep improving and pushing forward. The new TAURA line array made an excellent impression on me: pleasant, smooth and open sound, a beautiful sonic character. I wish the company continued growth and success, and I hope to see your loudspeakers on sound engineers’ and artists’ riders more often!
strings.Система обладает значительным запасом мо: The system has plenty of power reserve and generous headroom, which lets you unlock its full potential.
strings.На конгрессе звукорежиссёров компания DS: At the Sound Engineers Congress, DS PROAUDIO presented its new TAURA line array. The system has plenty of power reserve and generous headroom, which lets you unlock its full potential. I’d especially single out the cardioid subwoofers: a great complement to the line array.
strings.Я был на прослушивании линейного массива: I attended a TAURA line array listening session and really liked the system. It’s a strong candidate for both fixed installations and rental. The driver design really impressed me. I recommend it to everyone.
strings.основатель прокатного агентства Pro Even: founder of the Pro Event rental company, Urengoy
strings.В этом году послушал комплект Pillar от: This year I listened to the PILLAR system from DS PROAUDIO. A really lively-sounding system. I liked it. For mid-size venues it’s an excellent option.
strings.Выражаю благодарность компании DS PROAUD: I would like to thank DS PROAUDIO and its dealer in Perm Krai, TL Project, for supplying and tuning our ERA sound system.
strings.Система показала себя с наилучшей сторон: The system has proven itself in the best possible way: clean, balanced sound, high power and reliable equipment have significantly raised the quality of events in our hall. The new sound system lets us do justice to the whole range of music, from chamber concerts to large-scale shows.
strings.Отдельно хочу отметить работу звукоинжен: I’d especially like to mention the company’s sound engineers. Their professionalism, attentiveness and willingness to explain every detail of operating the equipment deserve the highest praise. Thanks to their tuning, the system was adapted to the acoustics of our hall, giving us the most accurate sound possible.
strings.С уверенностью могу рекомендовать акусти: I can confidently recommend DS PROAUDIO loudspeakers as a reliable, high-quality solution for cultural institutions and concert venues.
strings.Мне понравился «вкус» системы и её звуча: I liked the “flavor” of the system and its sound: I’d like to work with it more and really get to know it.
strings.Работали на акустике DS PROAUDIO Taura в: We worked on a DS PROAUDIO TAURA system with the band Severny Flot. Interesting loudspeakers: the sound is unusual, not what I’m used to, but very pleasant. Of course, it takes some getting used to, but the system was easy to work with.
strings.Мне понравился «вкус» системы и её звуча: I liked the “flavor” of the system and its sound: I’d like to work with it more and really get to know it. I’ll gladly do it again.
strings.Компания DS PROAUDIO, помню, начала свой: As I recall, DS PROAUDIO started out about six years ago, and I was involved in writing the first presets for their loudspeakers.
strings.Динамика развития этого бренда меня не у: The pace of this brand’s growth doesn’t surprise me, it inspires me! They’re developing so fast, boldly moving forward in this market and making exactly the products the market needs. I sincerely wish the company success and all the very best.
strings.Всем привет, меня зовут Дмитрий Абрамов: Hi everyone, my name is Dmitry Abramov and I run a sound and lighting equipment rental business. I already have DS PROAUDIO PILLAR loudspeakers in my rental stock, and they’re excellent! In the giveaway video you may have seen some of the photos we took at our venues and sent to the team. Big-name artists and bands are happy to perform on them. We set them up on boats, in private homes and at small conference venues. I recommend them to everyone, if you don’t have these loudspeakers yet. It’s pretty much the best purchase we’ve ever made!
